active_delegations.completion_delta: Continue the exhaustive Core/Foundation/Spine completion census from the first incomplete census segment after the newly closed SMR020 boundary; reconcile history into current completion, obligation, expectation, reallocation and evidence standing without re-running completed SMR018-SMR020 product qualification.
active_delegations.stop_condition: Every material Foundation/UAF/SMR/Data/Platform/Chat/Ops/UX/KEEL/Interop/Continuity/Assurance boundary inspected for this phase is classified as COMPLETED, OPEN_OBLIGATION, BLOCKED, SUPERSEDED, HISTORICAL_EVIDENCE, UNALLOCATED or EVIDENCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED, with exact source/evidence pointers where available; a durable resumable census checkpoint is committed before stopping.
allowed_work: completion-ledger additions backed by exact evidence
stale current-state documentation correction that does not alter historical evidence
forbidden_authority: do not transfer exact-SHA qualification between subjects
do not fabricate native Apple, human, private-data or external-authority evidence
do not rewrite historical receipts/artifacts to match new taxonomy
do not advance or implement SMR021 merely to create Second Shift activity
do not re-run the completed SMR018, SMR019 or SMR020 portable qualification trains unless new evidence invalidates a recorded result
active_delegations.on_pass: Remove this delegation from active_delegations, record the completed P1 Core census phase/checkpoint, update durable ledgers, then re-evaluate the live Core control head. Admit a successor only if independently justified.
active_delegations.on_failure: Preserve the completed census checkpoint, classify the exact unresolved boundary, remove or block this delegation as appropriate, and resume later from the first incomplete census segment rather than restarting P1.

retired_delegations.superseded_reason: CORE control head moved through SMR020 source-custody closure and local portable closure to SMR021; schema rule invalidates READY delegation on head mismatch.

reason: The prior census delegation became stale when the Core control head moved. Ordinary SMR021 product implementation remains day-shift/Core-owner work and is not delegated here.
